[ASSISTANT_SAID] Water-Resistant and Sports-Friendly options recommended: CeraVe, Coppertone, Hawaiian Tropic.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised to choose a sunscreen that suits skin type, apply liberally 15-30 minutes before going outside, and reapply every 2 hours.
